rounds.text: EIH Ltd (EIHOTEL) has demonstrated strong fundamentals over the past decade, with compounded profit growth of 33% in the last five years and a positive CAGR of 18%. This outperformance is evident from [E60] and further supported by [E57], indicating that the company's profitability exceeds expectations. Additionally, the sector median profit growth is at 17.4%, which EIHOTEL has surpassed with its compounded profit growth over three years at 21% (as per [E21]). Despite these positive indicators, the stock currently sits at a P/E ratio of 32.6 and a Price-to-Book (P/B) ratio of 4.36x, which are above sector benchmarks of 32.02x and 0.95x respectively (as per [E1] and [E7]). This suggests that the market may not fully appreciate the company's strong fundamentals, as its current valuation is higher than what the sector average would suggest. Conceded: [E64], indicating sales growth quarter-over-quarter, which could be a positive factor but does not directly address the under-appreciation of EIHOTEL's strong fundamentals.
